text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe has been lost in thought like that for a while now...
Is she nervous, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ART"...
Everyone's "signals" have been "analyzed."
I've prepared multiple "courses" as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "pulsar" is visualized.
Ready for "liftoff" anytime. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "I see the path to victory"... that is.
